title: Vitendawili (Theme 3: Mapambo)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 5 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child tells a riddle from a methali or nahau, gives the formula, and tests every clue before answering.
representations: a methali, a nahau and a riddle to sort
steps: Test an answer against each clue.
Say the answer; set a riddle back.

board.say: Ni kitu gani kiko viwili na kinavuka?

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child answers "macho" and sets one riddle of his own with the formula.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Ni kitendawili kipi?" Kwa nini "Haba na haba hujaza kibaba" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Kitendawili huficha jibu na humtaka mtu kukitegua. Methali hutoa funzo.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Ni kitendawili kipi?" Kwa nini "Kukata tamaa" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Nahau ni maneno yenye maana maalum. Kitendawili huuliza kwa mafumbo na kina jibu la kutegua.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Ni kitendawili kipi?" Kwa nini "Yai ni chakula kizuri" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Kitendawili hakitaji kitu moja kwa moja; hukielezea kwa fumbo. Sentensi ya kawaida inataja wazi.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: ""Popote niendapo hunifuata." Jibu ni nini?" Kwa nini "mbwa" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Jibu la kitendawili lazima lilingane na kila sehemu yake. Hiyo si jibu sahihi.

checks.question: Ni kipi ni kitendawili: "Haraka haraka haina baraka" au "Kila nikienda ananifuata"?
